I’ve always been the one to refuse to shut our government down.   

It’s always wrong and a complete betrayal of our core responsibility.

Now, we’ve made sure if that happens again, no Senator gets paid—the right move.

Confirmed: rapists, cowards and vile deviants.  

Volumes of incontrovertible evidence of the depravity of Hamas.

NYT preemptively dropped a grotesque op-ed with sources linked to Hamas for a beachhead of “bothsiderism” Hamas defenders.

A couple weeks ago, I sent a letter to FEMA on COVID-era reimbursements to PA’s hospitals that have been delayed for years.

Today, nearly $600 million is finally being released back to our commonwealth.

Thank you, @SecMullinDHS and @FEMA.

fetterman.senate.gov/at-fett…

ROONEY RULE

STEELERS

WESTERN PA 

COME AND TAKE IT.

I know David and his legendary father, Cyril. 

As I’ve affirmed, I’m not changing my party—but I fully understand David’s personal choice.

The Democratic Party must confront its own rising antisemitism problem.

PROUD to support our men and women in blue this National Police Week and always.

This week serves as a reminder of the difficult job our law enforcement has—especially when our great country has become so polarized.

Grateful to the Thin Blue Line that protects and serves. 🇺🇸

Stop this henpecking.   

$13M? This is an iconic American place and was in serious disrepair.  

Get over the TDS and celebrate this is getting done for our 250th. 🇺🇸

Assassinations + political violence are real.
 
My party can’t be the tin foil hat brigade.

I was there a table away and I promise you, this was not staged.

In Pennsylvania, across our country, abroad—wherever the moms find themselves today:

Wishing youse and yinz a HAPPY MOTHER’S DAY!

Mob of Pro-Hezbollah / Hamas shitheads raging against law enforcement and terrorizing the NYC Jewish community near a synagogue and day care.

Where’s my party’s condemnation?


Rabbi Poupko (@RabbiPoupko)

To summarize the evening: the mob came to a Synagogue, forced a Jewish day care to close early, came with a Hezbollah flag, cheered for intifada, and said "we don't want no Zionists here".

We cannot normalize this behavior.

Video

✅ DHS employees unpaid.

✅ 1000+ TSA agents quit.

✅ Zero ICE reforms.

✅ Nation less safe.

As the only Democrat who wanted commonsense ICE reforms but always refused to shut the agency down—this was unnecessary and a failure of Congress.


Burgess Everett (@burgessev)

The 75-day shutdown is over



— https://nitter.net/burgessev/status/2049899878247997770#m

SNAP to include HOT ROTISSERIE CHICKEN.

384-35! 

Doesn’t only include my crew’s favorite + affordable $4.99 Costco rotisserie 😜 — but ANY hot rotisserie.

Feeding families: a (rotisserie) chicken in every pot. 🇺🇸

Feed our busy and hardworking families with real food.

Costco’s hot rotisserie — $4.99.

We introduced a bipartisan bill to make our SNAP families’ lives a little more affordable + convenient in America. 🇺🇸 

fetterman.senate.gov/fetterm…

We were there front and center. 

That venue wasn’t built to accommodate an event with the line of succession for the U.S. government. 

After witnessing last night, drop the TDS and build the White House ballroom for events exactly like these.

Gisele and I are safe and back home.

We’re incredibly grateful for law enforcement and their quick reaction this evening.
